title: Grogu in Class
subtitle: The Journey of Grogu
description: Back on Nevarro to affect repairs on the Razor Crest, Grogu is left in the trusted care of a Teacher Droid at school while the Mandalorian conducts his business. In class, Grogu does his best to fit in with the other kids, but his stomach gets the best of him, and he decides to steal some delicious blue treats.
